title: The Voices Beneath the Water · Episode 19: Who Gets to Apply?

planning.voiceReason: An applicant faces exclusion under a deadline.
planning.earlyCare: Jon notices an applicant carefully protecting a worn paper resume.
planning.desire: Help a skilled outsider submit an application before the deadline.
planning.obstacle: A failed terminal and a qualification shortcut exclude a capable applicant.
planning.dramaticChange: He asks the applicant to speak for herself and makes the process accessible to everyone.
planning.sourceBoundary: A community hiring notice offers paid maintenance and centre-support work. A new applicant from another settlement has useful experience but no prestigious qualification. A broken application terminal and a dismissive gatekeeper threaten to exclude them. Jon and Min insist on a paper alternative and a relevant practical assessment.
sceneActivities: Jon and Min help at a hiring desk; Ryn carries a paper resume; Vek first refuses then accepts accessible applications. A supervised ground-level sample assessment follows; no actual roof work yet.

actingSignature.Jonathan: Plain practical questions; open hand at a boundary, quiet attention afterward.
actingSignature.An: Specific limits and short questions; supported seated rest while reviewing, no assumed healing.
actingSignature.Min: Urgent explanations soften into admitting uncertainty; rests attentive when corrected.
actingSignature.Mother: Concrete requests and accurate accounting; no presumed forgiveness or renewed station shift.
actingSignature.Sela: Patient concrete questions; does not reach for private report. Quiet open posture and attentive gaze.
actingSignature.Ivo: Begins with explanations and permissions; shifts to asking his son. Guarded hands, then release into attentive rest.

planning.listenerTurn: Ryn: I want you to hear me, not speak for me. Listener Jon; he steps back and leaves her the floor.
planning.payoff: Applications are accepted fairly; the crew selection proceeds by demonstrated skills and clear duties.
planning.freshQuestion: Candidates face a supervised practical interview. One assessor judges clothes and confidence instead of competence; another wants unpaid overtime to rush the opening. Min, sensitive about his own reputation, backs a fair skills test and written paid trial terms. The group rejects appearance-based selection and sets realistic staffing limits.

teaser.moment: Ryn stands at sunset beside the ground-level repair test she has completed, facing the distant damaged centre with determined composure.

planning.convergence: Every target gets two distinct meaningful uses on the common path; optional choice text is not the sole exposure. Choices change tone, approach and acknowledgment, not permanent plot branches.

englishAudio.text: Recruitment closes today, but the software has broken down.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: What will the applicants do?
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Let's listen to them first instead of sending them away.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: A woman stands beside the doorway, protecting a worn resume.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: My name is Ryn; I come from another settlement. I would like to apply to take responsibility for building repairs.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Welcome. I'm Jon; I help out here.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I don't hear news quickly; I was afraid of missing the recruitment.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: You haven't missed it. Let's check the record first.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: My previous employer gave me a letter recording what I have repaired.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Give me your resume; I am responsible for recording it. Tell me your qualifications first.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: The machine is broken; we can't say she arrived late.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: She is willing to speak, let us listen patiently first.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: My formal qualifications aren't high. But I've repaired many pipes, and have records from my previous employer.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: This job requires relevant experience. Having repaired pipes doesn't mean you can repair everything.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I didn't say that. Qualified people need to take responsibility for the roof; I know that.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Without qualifications, can you use software?
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Ah, the software is broken; it's not that I'm unwilling to use it.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: We can't turn a software problem into discrimination against a person.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Is that discrimination? I also have requirements from the employer.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: The recruitment requirements and experience need to match. She says she has records; you haven't looked at them yet.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I'm good at inspecting pipes and at noticing small problems.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: But I don't promise to do things I can't do. You can test me.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I can speak for her, what she means is—
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I want you to listen to me, not answer for me.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I close my mouth and stop speaking.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Go ahead. I'm listening.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: A broken machine mustn't shut people out. Records on paper deserve a look too.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Don't open the door for Ryn alone. Other people must be able to apply too.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: This organization wants to recruit responsible people, not whoever is best at filling out forms.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Then give me the resumes now, I will record who arrived before the deadline.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: We must also notify everyone that paper resumes are accepted.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: What is the wage? What would I be responsible for?
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: The wage and working hours are recorded here. I give everyone the same record.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I want to know the requirements first rather than just hear that the prospects are good.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Prospects cannot replace wages. What you want to know, we will explain.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: We record resumes today, and respond tomorrow. Whether or not someone is hired, we respond to everyone.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Thank you. Without friends who hear news quickly, I haven't been shut out.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Ah, I was afraid of running out of time; yet had no patience to listen to you.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I am confident and ready to be assessed, but I want to know what you're assessing.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Safety comes first; then we listen to your conclusions. We do not demand risk-taking.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Standards must not change secretly. State the requirements first then assess.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: This is a safe practice area, we won't ask anyone to risk repairing the roof.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: A qualified specialist inspects the practice area. The old pipe on the table is disconnected from any water supply.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: At this stage, we are assessing judgment and safety. We are not assessing personality.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: When getting along with others, I may not say much. But I am good at communicating safety requirements.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Being quiet does not mean being hard to get along with. We'll listen to how you investigate.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Physics is relevant to safety. Look at the support beneath the pipe.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: But what chemical hazards are present here? I won't touch anything I don't understand.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: There are no chemicals; we're only examining a clean empty pipe.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I don't recognize this foreign-language passage. Please explain it to me first, I mustn't guess.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Admitting what you don't know is part of professional competence too.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Passing doesn't mean never asking a question. Knowing when to stop also counts in the result.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: For this task, I'll inspect this part first. The support hasn't been secured properly.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: She stops first and points it out to the specialist, then secures it again as instructed.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Let my work speak. I don't ask you to rely only on my words.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Who wrote this article? It contains inspection records.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: The specialist at my former workplace wrote it. Since the storm, I've kept it with me.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: You take the effort to keep records, we must also take the effort to check them.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I'm not demanding that you hire me. I want a real interview.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Helping someone, does not mean answering everything for them.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Let those who come later know what to do; they shouldn't have to face the same rejection again.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I realize I mustn't talk about fairness only among friends.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I feel more confident now. Not because you've promised me a job, but because you're willing to assess me carefully.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: The sunset lights the practice bench. Ryn looks toward the distant building, in no hurry to leave.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: All the resumes have been recorded, everyone's records still need checking. The building is still unrepaired.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: The water is the same as before, we still remember our earlier promises. Tomorrow, we'll wait for the official response.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Record when she arrived first.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Listen to her experience first.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Ask them to accept the written records.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Ask for everyone to have the same options.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Explain the requirements to everyone first.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Inspect the practice area first.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Listen to applicants first in future.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Record today’s procedure.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.
